title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
description: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad
description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the execution of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

title: Russell Brand accuser says alleged rape left her afraid she may be pregnant
description: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
description: Reservoir levels continue to drop after a hot summer and less September rain than normal.

title: Infantino apologises to Fifa Council - but told he's still not fit to lead
description: President Gianni Infantino apologises to the Fifa Council for his World Cup sell-off plan - but is asked to go further.

title: Man killed by tiger climbed two fences before suffering multiple injuries, inquest hears
description: William Chapman climbed two fences to enter a tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, an inquest hears.

title: Watch: Swimmer's emotional TV plea for cancer research leads to meeting with PM
description: Scottish athlete, Archie Goodburn, who was diagnosed with three inoperable brain tumours two years ago, met Andy Burnham after an appeal for more investment into brain cancer research.

title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
description: Ukraine's president says a pause on striking energy sites is over following fresh Russian attacks.

title: Another man admits raping woman drugged by husband over 20 years
description: The husband is accused of inviting 13 other men to abuse her at their family home in Stockport.
